name: Your system
rules: Uses your screener on coins: last night's setups (Momentum and Pullback) on the strongest category, strongest coin list (your rule, from Oct 14): the coin is in your uptrend, its category is turning up and rising (its breadth above its 10-day average), and it goes highest score first. The score is 40% the market (crypto market breadth), 40% the category (its breadth) and 20% the coin (its relative strength rank inside its category). Last night = the screener run after the day's bar closed at midnight UTC (7 PM Central in winter, 8 PM in summer).

Holds 2 positions at a time, and never spends more than 30% of the account on one buy. Buys and sells at about 10:00 New York time, every day (coins trade on weekends too), then checks its exits every 30 minutes until 5:45 PM New York time.

Buys the coin itself. The stock version buys a call by your option rules (15-30 days out, delta 0.50-0.80, open interest over 500); coins have no options a normal brokerage account can buy, so it does what the stock version does when no call fits: buys the top setup outright.
Takes the first of the top 15 setups that passes the checks when it buys, and skips a setup that has dropped below its 50-day EMA by then.

Your overbought rule: it doesn't buy anything with RSI over 70 or CCI over 100 (checked on the live price when it buys), or while the market's breadth or the coin's category's is over the 75 line (the share of its coins with the 10 EMA over the 20 and price over the 50 EMA, last night).

Your exit (from Oct 14): it enters on the daily chart and sells on the 4-hour chart, once a 4-hour bar closes with the 10 EMA under the 20 EMA and the price under the 50 EMA, both at once. The bars are the Trend view's 4H bars (4 hours each from midnight UTC) and only bars that close after the buy count. It sells at the next check after the bar closes; bars that close overnight sell at about 10:00 New York time.
Safety net, my default: it also sells if the coin drops 8%.
fills: Paper trades, no real money. Coins fill at Yahoo's latest 1-minute price, 0.05% worse, and fractions of a coin are allowed. No exchange fee is charged; real exchanges charge about 0.1% to 0.6% a trade.
